lines.zh: 我一瘸一拐，却始终与你隔着十步。
lines.en: I limp along, always staying ten paces from you.

lines.zh: 腐肉下面，旧布条一节节松开。
lines.en: Old cloth strips come loose beneath my rotten flesh.

lines.zh: 巨怪走路，地面先叹一口气。
lines.en: When a troll walks, the ground sighs first.

lines.zh: 我退着走，符文在掌心发烫。
lines.en: I walk backwards, runes burning hot in my palm.

lines.zh: 格瑞克的灰落满我的肩。
lines.en: The ash of Greckon settles thick on my shoulders.

lines.zh: 每一步都掉下几片破布屑。
lines.en: Every step sheds a few scraps of torn cloth.

lines.zh: 你追不上我，我本就不打算近身。
lines.en: You cannot catch me; I never meant to fight up close.

lines.zh: 骨节在皮里磨，像旧门轴。
lines.en: Bones grind inside my hide like an old door hinge.

lines.zh: 我绕着你转，数着你的脚步。
lines.en: I circle you, counting every step you take.

lines.zh: 水符文在腰间叮当作响。
lines.en: Water runes clink softly at my hip.

lines.zh: 别靠太近，我讨厌别人的热气。
lines.en: Do not come close; I dislike the warmth of the living.

lines.zh: 我拖着一只脚，也拖着一整袋符文。
lines.en: I drag one foot, and a whole sack of runes.

lines.zh: 我站着，像一截被雷劈过的树。
lines.en: I stand still, like a tree split by lightning.

lines.zh: 风穿过肋骨，吹出低低的哨音。
lines.en: Wind passes my ribs and whistles low.

lines.zh: 我把布匹摊开，数上面的洞。
lines.en: I spread the cloth and count its holes.

lines.zh: 三颗火符文，够烧一间屋子。
lines.en: Three fire runes; enough to burn a house.

lines.zh: 死人不需要呼吸，可我还是喘。
lines.en: The dead need no breath, yet I still pant.

lines.zh: 我用指骨敲着自己的膝盖。
lines.en: I tap my kneecap with a bare finger bone.

lines.zh: 格瑞克没有太阳，正合我意。
lines.en: Greckon has no sun, which suits me.

lines.zh: 谁把我的线头又扯开了。
lines.en: Who has pulled my stitching loose again?

lines.zh: 我听见远处有活物在喘。
lines.en: I hear something living breathing far away.

lines.zh: 站久了，脚底陷进灰里。
lines.en: Standing long, my feet sink into the ash.

lines.zh: 你的眼睛还在转，真新鲜。
lines.en: Your eyes still move; how fresh.

lines.zh: 我盯着你，像盯着一块没缝的布。
lines.en: I stare at you like cloth still unstitched.

lines.zh: 活人的味道，从你袖口漏出来。
lines.en: The smell of the living leaks from your sleeve.

lines.zh: 别眨眼，我想看清你怎么怕。
lines.en: Do not blink; I want to watch you fear.

lines.zh: 你比我上次见的那伙人矮。
lines.en: You are shorter than the last lot I saw.

lines.zh: 眼窝里是空的，可你在我视野里。
lines.en: My sockets are hollow, yet you fall inside my sight.

lines.zh: 你把符文藏在哪只口袋里。
lines.en: Which pocket are you hiding runes in?

lines.zh: 我数过你的手指，十根，完好。
lines.en: I counted your fingers: ten, all whole.

lines.zh: 你这样站着，很像等着被缝起来。
lines.en: Standing like that, you look ready to be stitched.

lines.zh: 我记住你走路的声音了。
lines.en: I have memorized the sound of your walk.

lines.zh: 你砍开一道口子，里面是空的。
lines.en: You open a gash; there is nothing inside.

lines.zh: 我疼得很慢，你要等。
lines.en: My pain comes slowly; you will have to wait.

lines.zh: 这一下砍断了两根旧线。
lines.en: That blow cut two old stitches.

lines.zh: 我的符文撒了一地，帮我捡？
lines.en: My runes spilled everywhere; care to help?

lines.zh: 血早干了，只有灰掉下来。
lines.en: The blood dried long ago; only ash falls out.

lines.zh: 你打得不错，可惜我不怕散架。
lines.en: Good hit, but falling apart does not scare me.

lines.zh: 我退半步，把伤口对着你。
lines.en: I step back half a pace, turning the wound to you.

lines.zh: 这一刀让我想起生前的事。
lines.en: That cut reminds me of something from before death.

lines.zh: 布条松了，我的肩要掉了。
lines.en: The cloth loosened; my shoulder is coming off.

lines.zh: 再来，我这副身子还能挨几下。
lines.en: Again; this body can take a few more.

lines.zh: 食物？我的胃早就不在了。
lines.en: Food? My stomach left long ago.

lines.zh: 你举着面包，我只闻到布的味道。
lines.en: You raise bread; I only smell cloth.

lines.zh: 亡灵不吃东西，只收集符文。
lines.en: The undead do not eat; we collect runes.

lines.zh: 收起来吧，那玩意儿引不来我。
lines.en: Put it away; that thing will not draw me.

lines.zh: 我饿，但饿的是别的部位。
lines.en: I am hungry, but the hunger is elsewhere.

lines.zh: 你要喂我，不如递一块破布。
lines.en: To feed me, hand over torn cloth instead.

lines.zh: 这味道让我想起自己的葬礼。
lines.en: That smell reminds me of my own funeral.

lines.zh: 我摇头，颈骨咔地响了一声。
lines.en: I shake my head; my neck clicks once.

lines.zh: 活人的食物，留给活人吧。
lines.en: Leave the food of the living to the living.

lines.zh: 别晃了，我不会跟过去的。
lines.en: Stop waving it; I will not follow.

lines.zh: 撞我一下，你肩上会沾灰。
lines.en: Bump me and your shoulder picks up ash.

lines.zh: 我的皮比你想的硬，也比你想的凉。
lines.en: My hide is harder than you think, and colder.

lines.zh: 退开，你踩到我的布了。
lines.en: Back off; you stepped on my cloth.

lines.zh: 别贴这么近，我会以为你要缝我。
lines.en: Not so close; I might think you mean to stitch me.

lines.zh: 骨头撞骨头，响得像空桶。
lines.en: Bone strikes bone and rings like an empty barrel.

lines.zh: 我这副身子，撞一下掉一块。
lines.en: One bump and a piece of me falls off.

lines.zh: 你撞得我符文都错位了。
lines.en: You knocked my runes out of place.

lines.zh: 巨怪的肩膀不是给人靠的。
lines.en: A troll's shoulder is not for leaning on.

lines.zh: 我侧身让开，脚下扬起灰。
lines.en: I step aside; ash rises under my feet.

lines.zh: 再撞，我就退到箭都够不着。
lines.en: Bump again and I retreat beyond arrow range.

lines.zh: 这副身体早就断了那念想。
lines.en: This body gave up that thought long ago.

lines.zh: 巨怪的伴侣，埋在格瑞克的灰下。
lines.en: A troll's mate lies buried under Greckon ash.

lines.zh: 你问这个，是笑话一具尸骨吗。
lines.en: You ask that, mocking a pile of bones?

lines.zh: 我不繁殖，我只收集和投掷。
lines.en: I do not breed; I collect and I throw.

lines.zh: 布条缠得再紧，也缠不回从前。
lines.en: No cloth wrapped tight can bring back before.

lines.zh: 亡灵没有后代，只有留下的洞。
lines.en: The undead leave no children, only holes.

lines.zh: 我连自己的名字都记不全了。
lines.en: I cannot even recall my own full name.

lines.zh: 巨怪不谈婚事，只谈下一颗符文。
lines.en: A troll does not court; he counts the next rune.

lines.zh: 我把这句话当作一种冒犯。
lines.en: I take that question as an insult.

lines.zh: 走开，让我一个人守着符文。
lines.en: Go away and let me guard my runes alone.

lines.zh: 我弯腰捡起一颗水符文。
lines.en: I stoop and pick up a water rune.

lines.zh: 这布片还能再缝一次。
lines.en: This scrap of cloth can be stitched once more.

lines.zh: 掉在地上的，都归巨怪。
lines.en: Whatever falls to the ground belongs to the troll.

lines.zh: 我用两根指骨把它夹起来。
lines.en: I lift it with two bare finger bones.

lines.zh: 火符文烫手，我照样塞进袋里。
lines.en: The fire rune burns, but I pocket it anyway.

lines.zh: 你掉的这枚，我替你收着。
lines.en: You dropped this one; I will keep it for you.

lines.zh: 我捡东西很慢，但从不落下。
lines.en: I pick things up slowly, but I never miss one.

lines.zh: 这堆破布里裹着什么硬东西。
lines.en: Something hard is wrapped in this rag pile.

lines.zh: 归我了，你可以再丢一次。
lines.en: Mine now; you may drop another.

lines.zh: 我低下巨大的头，灰落了一地。
lines.en: I lower my huge head and ash falls everywhere.

lines.zh: 找到你了，隔着二十步也找到。
lines.en: Found you, even twenty paces out.

lines.zh: 我的符文开始发亮，说明你该跑了。
lines.en: My runes begin to glow; that means run.

lines.zh: 活物，站住，让我瞄准。
lines.en: Living thing, stand still and let me aim.

lines.zh: 你踩断的枯枝替你报了名。
lines.en: The twig you snapped announced your name.

lines.zh: 我不靠近，我只需要一条直线。
lines.en: I do not close in; I only need a straight line.

lines.zh: 这具旧身子，终于有点用处。
lines.en: This old body finally has some use.

lines.zh: 布匹下的手已经抬起来了。
lines.en: The hand beneath the cloth is already raised.

lines.zh: 你进了格瑞克，就该知道规矩。
lines.en: You entered Greckon; you should know the rules.

lines.zh: 我锁住你，像缝住一道口子。
lines.en: I lock onto you like stitching a seam shut.

lines.zh: 别躲到树后，我扔得很准。
lines.en: Do not hide behind trees; my aim is good.

lines.zh: 目标确认，符文就位。
lines.en: Target confirmed; the runes are in place.

lines.zh: 我的呼吸停了，你的还没。
lines.en: My breathing stopped; yours has not.

lines.zh: 我看见你了，就不用再找了。
lines.en: Now that I see you, I need not search.

lines.zh: 跑吧，让我看看你能跑多远。
lines.en: Run, and let me see how far you get.

lines.zh: 你身上的铁味，我隔着雾都闻到。
lines.en: I smell the iron on you through the fog.

lines.zh: 我数到三就扔，你最好动起来。
lines.en: I throw at three; you had better move.

lines.zh: 你往左，我的符文就往左。
lines.en: You go left; my rune goes left too.

lines.zh: 保持距离，这是我唯一的手艺。
lines.en: Keeping distance is my only craft.

lines.zh: 你盾牌举得太高，腋下空着。
lines.en: Your shield rides too high; your armpit shows.

lines.zh: 我在等你露出膝盖。
lines.en: I am waiting for you to expose a knee.

lines.zh: 火焰符文先走，水符文随后。
lines.en: The fire rune goes first; the water one follows.

lines.zh: 你脚步一乱，我手里的符文就醒。
lines.en: One stumble and the rune in my hand wakes.

lines.zh: 我不用追，你总会撞进我的线。
lines.en: I need not chase; you will cross my line.

lines.zh: 这层灰让我看不清，但够用。
lines.en: The ash blurs my sight, but it will do.

lines.zh: 你躲一下，我就换一颗符文。
lines.en: Dodge once and I switch to another rune.

lines.zh: 别以为我慢，投掷不需要快跑。
lines.en: Do not think me slow; throwing needs no running.

lines.zh: 我盯着你的胸口，那里最容易。
lines.en: I watch your chest; it is the easiest mark.

lines.zh: 你在喘，说明我还有时间。
lines.en: You are panting; that means I still have time.

lines.zh: 我抬起手，你就该低头了。
lines.en: When my hand rises, you should duck.

lines.zh: 我把水符文捏在指间，凉的。
lines.en: I pinch a water rune between my fingers. It's cold.

lines.zh: 你躲在树后，树不够宽。
lines.en: You hide behind a tree. The tree is too narrow.

lines.zh: 我往后退半步，是为了扔得更远。
lines.en: I step back half a pace to throw farther.

lines.zh: 你冲过来，那正好省我几步。
lines.en: You charge. That saves me a few steps.

lines.zh: 你贴上来，我只能用拳头。
lines.en: You closed in, so a fist will have to do.

lines.zh: 这一掌带着火符文的余温。
lines.en: This palm still carries the fire rune's warmth.

lines.zh: 我打得不漂亮，但很沉。
lines.en: My swing is ugly, but it lands heavy.

lines.zh: 布条缠住的拳头砸在你肩上。
lines.en: A cloth-wrapped fist comes down on your shoulder.

lines.zh: 别逼我近身，我不擅长这个。
lines.en: Do not force me close; this is not my strength.

lines.zh: 你听见骨头相碰的声音了吗。
lines.en: Did you hear bone meeting bone?

lines.zh: 我推你一把，你退回去三格。
lines.en: One shove from me sends you back three blocks.

lines.zh: 远程才是我的活，你偏要凑近。
lines.en: Ranged is my work; you insisted on coming close.

lines.zh: 破布散开，露出的指骨还在砸。
lines.en: My rags fall open; bare knuckles keep pounding.

lines.zh: 这一下不够，我再补一记。
lines.en: That was not enough; here is another.

lines.zh: 我喘着，把力道压进肩膀。
lines.en: Panting, I drive the force through my shoulder.

lines.zh: 你身上的铁，撞得我手发麻。
lines.en: The iron on you numbs my hand.

lines.zh: 我在退，可我的手还在前面。
lines.en: I am retreating, yet my hand stays forward.

lines.zh: 挨完这拳，你该明白要跑。
lines.en: After this punch, you should know to run.

lines.zh: 我抡起手臂，布条散开了。
lines.en: I swing my arm and the cloth strips come loose.

lines.zh: 这一下砸在你盾沿上，手麻吗。
lines.en: That hit your shield rim. Numb yet?

lines.zh: 我从灰里站起来，布条还挂着土。
lines.en: I rise from the ash, cloth still caked with dirt.

lines.zh: 格瑞克又多了一个站着的死人。
lines.en: Greckon has one more standing dead man.

lines.zh: 符文先落地，我才睁眼。
lines.en: The runes land first; only then do I open my eyes.

lines.zh: 这具身体是拼起来的，别细看。
lines.en: This body was pieced together; do not look closely.

lines.zh: 我又回来了，记性比上次差。
lines.en: I am back, with a worse memory than last time.

lines.zh: 谁把我埋得这么浅。
lines.en: Who buried me this shallow?

lines.zh: 我一站起来，就欠着三颗水符文。
lines.en: I rise already owing three water runes.

lines.zh: 空气里有铁锈和旧布的味道。
lines.en: The air tastes of rust and old cloth.

lines.zh: 我活动手指，关节像撒了沙。
lines.en: I flex my fingers; the joints grind like sand.

lines.zh: 这地方够暗，适合我这种人。
lines.en: This place is dark enough for my kind.

lines.zh: 我的影子比身体先站稳。
lines.en: My shadow steadies before my body does.

lines.zh: 从土里带出来的，还有半袋符文。
lines.en: I brought half a sack of runes out of the soil.

lines.zh: 别急着打，先让我把线缝好。
lines.en: Do not rush to fight; let me finish stitching.

lines.zh: 巨怪醒了，这一带要安静了。
lines.en: The troll wakes; this area will go quiet.

lines.zh: 火符文认我，你的火不认。
lines.en: Fire runes know me; your flame does not.

lines.zh: 摔下来，我听见自己内部在响。
lines.en: Falling, I hear my insides rattle.

lines.zh: 水淹不死已经死过一次的。
lines.en: Water cannot drown what already died once.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我炸散，又炸回一起。
lines.en: The blast scatters me, then blows me back together.

lines.zh: 箭插在布上，像多了一根针。
lines.en: The arrow sticks in cloth like an extra needle.

lines.zh: 魔法烧过符文，留下蓝痕。
lines.en: Magic scorches my runes and leaves blue marks.

lines.zh: 胃早没了，饿是留在骨头里的。
lines.en: No stomach left; hunger stays in the bones.

lines.zh: 雷落在旧骨头上，亮得刺眼。
lines.en: Lightning on old bone burns bright.

lines.zh: 虚空在拉我，我本来就空。
lines.en: The void pulls at me; I was empty already.
